title: Account queries concatenate input
description: Register, login and save use SQL with user input.
claimed_root_cause: Register, login and save use SQL with user input.

evidence.description: Every query uses placeholders; handles match a pattern and bodies are capped at 64 KiB with unknown fields rejected.

title: Railway service runs as uid 0 despite the non-root image user
description: The Dockerfile drops to user `app`, but the Railway IaC sets RAILWAY_RUN_UID to 0 (needed to write the mounted volume), so the process may run as root.

trace.description: The Go process runs with root privileges inside the container.

evidence.description: RAILWAY_RUN_UID is "0" while the Dockerfile sets USER app.

blockers: Whether a volume group id or ownership setting would let the service run unprivileged is Railway platform behaviour outside the repository.

validation_plan.local: Read the Railway volume permission documentation.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner tests RAILWAY_RUN_UID=1000 with a volume ownership fix in a staging environment.

title: Score SVG rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML executes script
description: LibraryPlayer injects fetched SVG pages into the DOM.
claimed_root_cause: LibraryPlayer injects fetched SVG pages into the DOM.

evidence.description: Pages are produced by the pinned LilyPond, pass an allowlist sanitizer at build (elements, attributes, DTD, style checks) and are checked by SHA-256 and a URL prefix before use.

reason: Content is build-time curated and sanitized, not user supplied.
